{{Top|leg}}
'''Anti-speciesism''' was the idea that [[speciesism]] was inherently wrong in every way. Whereas speciesism discriminated against other species of the galaxy, anti-speciesism defied the idea and sought to abolish it in all forms, especially [[Humanocentrism]] and [[Anti-Humanism]].

The [[Rights of Sentience]] clause of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] promoted this ideal alongside the [[Rights of Sentience League]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] practiced this as a way to protect all instead of just some, and so did the [[New Jedi Order]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rights of Sentience Party]] promoted this concept during the government's reign.
